subtitle.zh: 从浦东深夜落地，到素万那普清晨告别
subtitle.en: From a midnight touchdown to a morning farewell at Suvarnabhumi

intro.zh:
「旅行的意义不在于抵达终点，
而是我们度过的那些无可替代的时光」
intro.en:
“The meaning of travel is not in the arrival,
but in the irreplaceable hours we pass along the way.”

paragraphs.zh: 下午工作结束匆匆赶去机场，在浦东 T1 卫星厅的 VIP Lounge 吃上了面和小馄饨，旅程就这样开始了。
paragraphs.en: Rushed to the airport straight after work. Ate noodles and little wontons in the T1 satellite VIP lounge at Pudong. And with that, the trip began.

event.zh: 下班出发，赶往浦东机场
event.en: Left the office, headed for Pudong

detail.zh: 工作日赶飞机，心情已经飞到曼谷了
detail.en: Workday takeoff — mind already in Bangkok

event.en: Arrived at the satellite VIP lounge

detail.zh: 吃上了面和小馄饨，等待登机 ☕
detail.en: Noodles, wontons, a quiet wait before boarding ☕

event.zh: 落地曼谷素万那普机场

detail.zh: 入境排队人好多，排了将近一小时
detail.en: Immigration queue was massive — almost an hour

detail.zh: 用了高德的优惠，但机场的4层找了半天
detail.en: Used a Gaode coupon, but spent ages hunting the level-4 pickup

detail.zh: Silom 区，位置很方便，洗漱睡觉 😴

body.zh: 曼谷素万那普机场（BKK）是泰国最大的国际机场，距市区约30公里，打车到 Silom 区大约40-60分钟。建议提前下载好 Grab APP，曼谷打车基本靠它。入境排队通常30-60分钟，深夜航班人更多，耐心等待。泰铢汇率约 1 CNY = 4.5 THB。
body.en: Suvarnabhumi (BKK) is Thailand's largest international airport, ~30 km from the city. Taxi to Silom runs 40–60 minutes. Install Grab before you leave — it's how Bangkok moves. Immigration queues are usually 30–60 minutes, longer for late-night flights. Exchange rate roughly 1 CNY ≈ 4.5 THB.

paragraphs.zh:
深夜落地的曼谷，湿热的空气裹挟而来，
属于泰国的故事正式开始。
paragraphs.en:
Landed in Bangkok deep in the night. The humid air wrapped around us,
and the Thailand chapter officially began.

subtitle.zh: Friday, April 3rd · Silom · Lumpini Park · BACC
subtitle.en: Friday, April 3rd · Silom · Lumpini Park · BACC

caption.zh: 酒店窗外的曼谷 — 第一眼就被天际线震撼
caption.en: Bangkok from the hotel window — that skyline, right away

paragraphs.zh: 睡到下午才出门觅食，第一顿泰餐在 Ginger Green Farm Kitchen，连锁餐厅口味一般，但这碗 Khao Soi 还是给了惊喜。
paragraphs.en: Slept in until late afternoon, then went looking for lunch. First Thai meal at Ginger Green Farm Kitchen — a chain, fine but unremarkable. The khao soi, though, was the surprise of the meal.

caption.zh: Khao Soi 🍜 香浓的咖喱汤底

paragraphs.zh: 伦披尼公园不用门票，曼谷市中心最大的绿地，占地57公顷。吸氧发呆超舒服，还看到了体长达2米的巨蜥（Water Monitor）在游泳！不用怕，它们不攻击人。
paragraphs.en: Lumpini Park is free — 57 hectares of green in the middle of the city. Perfect for an afternoon of doing nothing in particular. And there it was: a two-meter water monitor swimming past like it owned the place. Don't worry — they don't attack people.

body.zh: 免费开放，下午3-5点去最舒服。公园有湖泊、棕榈树和巨蜥，吸氧发呆绝佳去处。距离 Silom 区步行10分钟。
body.en: Free admission. Best around 3–5 PM when the sun softens. Lake, palms, and yes — the monitor lizards. Ten minutes on foot from Silom.

subtitle.zh: BACC · Siam · 朱拉隆功夜市 · 姐娟海鲜
subtitle.en: BACC · Siam · Chula Night Market · Jae Keang

paragraphs.zh: 朱拉隆功夜市超级热闹，松松海鲜排队太久，转战姐娟海鲜 Jae Keang，鲈鱼超级好评！
paragraphs.en: The Chula night market was packed. Song Song Seafood had a queue we couldn't justify, so we pivoted to Jae Keang. The sea bass — honestly worth every minute of wandering.

caption.zh: 松松海鲜 🦀 排队太久

body.zh: 网红店人太多，尝了下味道一般，不值得大排长龙。但包装确实很可爱～
body.en: Viral for the packaging, but the drinks themselves are… fine. Not worth the line. Packaging is genuinely adorable, though.

subtitle.zh: Saturday, April 4th · Northeast 泰餐 · Wat Paknam

paragraphs.zh: 午餐在 Northeast，韩国人开的泰餐店，跟着韩国人吃准没错！冬阴功汤味道很正，大虾空心菜也很好吃。
paragraphs.en: Lunch at Northeast, a Thai restaurant run by Koreans — follow the Koreans and you won't go wrong. The tom yum tastes the way tom yum is supposed to taste, and the prawn stir-fried morning glory was excellent.

paragraphs.zh: 下午开启水门寺的"四个机位"打卡之旅，金色大佛在不同角度都有不同的震撼。
paragraphs.en: Afternoon: the Wat Paknam four-angle pilgrimage. The giant golden Buddha lands differently from each viewpoint.

caption.zh: 河边视角的金色大佛 — 本次旅行最震撼的一幕
caption.en: The river-side view — the most stunning moment of the trip

body.zh:
#1 Mama Cafe 巷子口拍大佛全景 | #2 造船厂咖啡 20🐷门票抵扣饮品
#3 水门寺本寺 拍大佛全身像 | #4 Talat Phlu 河边视角，还能看到卧佛
body.en:
#1 Mama Cafe — the classic alleyway-framed wide shot | #2 Shipyard Coffee — 20฿ entry, deducted from your drink
#3 Wat Paknam itself — full-body portrait of the Buddha | #4 Talat Phlu — across the river, where you can also see the Reclining Buddha

subtitle.zh: Pop Mart · 曼谷天际线 · 和幸晚餐
subtitle.en: Pop Mart · Bangkok skyline · Wako dinner

paragraphs.zh: 傍晚转战 Icon Siam，这是曼谷最豪华的河边商场，位于湄南河西岸，2018年开业，总面积52万平米。顶楼的 Pop Mart 超大，室外露台拍照打卡，曼谷天际线尽收眼底。
paragraphs.en: Evening pivot to Icon Siam — Bangkok's most lavish riverside mall, on the west bank of the Chao Phraya, opened 2018, 520,000 square meters. The rooftop Pop Mart is enormous, the outdoor terrace is where the skyline photos happen, and you get all of Bangkok in one frame.

caption.zh: Icon Siam 顶楼的曼谷天际线
caption.en: The Bangkok skyline from the top

paragraphs.zh: 在商场收获不少：阿迪达斯 Climacool 鞋子一双，Alo 篮球短裤，Divana 和 Journal 香薰。还帮朋友代购了屈臣氏。另外，肖战成功拦下了一个星巴克 Stanley 联名杯子，史称"星巴克百元咖啡杯事变"。
paragraphs.en: The haul: Adidas Climacool, Alo basketball shorts, Divana and Journal home fragrances. Also a Watsons run for a friend. And — a Stanley × Starbucks collab cup acquired in dramatic fashion, later nicknamed the “hundred-yuan Starbucks cup incident.”

body.zh: Icon Siam 打车离开很难，Grab 完全打不到。可以乘坐金线转绿线 BTS 顺利离开。商场内有泰国的"水上市场"复刻版，G层有各种泰国街头小吃，值得逛逛。
body.en: Leaving Icon Siam by Grab is a nightmare — cars just don't come. Take the BTS Gold Line, transfer to Green Line, and you're out. Inside the mall, there's a replica floating market and the G-floor has proper Thai street-food stalls. Worth an hour of wandering.

subtitle.zh: Sunday, April 5th · 泳池 · Nachapt · Bean Coffee
subtitle.en: Sunday, April 5th · Pool · Nachapt · Bean Coffee

paragraphs.zh: 今天是慢节奏的一天。上午在酒店泳池晒太阳，下午去 CentralPark 吃美食、喝咖啡。
paragraphs.en: A slow-tempo day. Morning in the hotel pool in the sun. Afternoon at Central Park — food and coffee.

comment.zh: 蟹肉很多很新鲜，强烈推荐！
comment.en: Generous, fresh crab meat. Strongly recommend.

comment.zh: 米其林小店聚集，猪蹄不错
comment.en: Cluster of Michelin stalls. The pork knuckle is good.

title.zh: 伴手礼 & 小象 · 下

subtitle.zh: Good Goods · Panpuri · Pop Mart · 毛巾小象
subtitle.en: Good Goods · Panpuri · Pop Mart · Towel elephant

paragraphs.zh: 在 Good Goods 挑了伴手礼，蓝白格编织包和香薰超适合送人。还去 Panpuri 买了滚珠香水，均价300多一只很值得。
paragraphs.en: Picked up gifts at Good Goods — the blue-and-white woven bag and the incense make great presents. Then Panpuri, where the rollerball perfumes at ~300 THB each felt like a steal.

detail.zh: 编织包+小象挂件+香薰蜡烛
小春野/木鱼敲/比奇堡2代

paragraphs.zh: 回到酒店发现了超可爱的毛巾小象！用 100🐷 换的，超级开心，泰国行程完美落幕。
paragraphs.en: Back at the hotel, a discovery: a towel elephant! Traded for 100 THB. The perfect note to close the trip on.

caption.zh: 🐘 毛巾小象 — 本次旅行的 MVP
caption.en: 🐘 Towel elephant — MVP of the trip

paragraphs.zh: 最后一天，硬着头皮起床吃早餐，拿了一盒纳豆尝尝咸淡，差点被送走——一股子臭鞋垫子味道。
paragraphs.en: Last day. Dragged myself up for breakfast, grabbed a box of natto to give it a fair shot, and nearly tapped out — the smell can only be described as “old shoe insole.”

detail.zh: 素万那普机场效率真的很低…

paragraphs.zh:
飞机滑行15分钟才停下来，也是绝了。
但泰国的故事，已经装进了这本手帐里。
paragraphs.en:
The plane taxied 15 full minutes before it stopped — incredible.
But the Thailand story is already packed into this journal.

subtitle.en: Seven restaurants in four days, honest review

comment.zh: 韩国人开的泰餐 性价比口味都很绝 364THB/人
comment.en: Korean-run Thai. Price and taste both excellent. ~364 THB/person

comment.zh: 松松边上人少 鲈鱼超好评 430THB/人
comment.en: Next to Song Song but calmer. Sea bass is outstanding. ~430 THB/person

comment.zh: 有点小贵但蟹肉真的很不错 892THB/人
comment.en: A bit pricey, but the crab delivers. ~892 THB/person

comment.zh: 米其林小店聚集 猪蹄和海南鸡都好吃 ~400THB/人
comment.en: A cluster of Michelin stalls — pork knuckle and Hainan chicken both good. ~400 THB/person

comment.zh: 连锁餐厅 口味一般价格贵 430THB/人
comment.en: Chain energy. Unremarkable food, prices too high. ~430 THB/person

comment.zh: 和日本比差很多 不推荐 495THB/人
comment.en: Nowhere near the Japan original. Skip. ~495 THB/person

comment.zh: 吃了个寂寞和臭晕的纳豆 470THB/人
comment.en: A hollow experience. And the natto. ~470 THB/person

paragraphs.zh: 4天3晚，从深夜落地到清晨离开，
paragraphs.en: Four days, three nights — from a midnight landing to a morning farewell.

paragraphs.zh: 吃了美食，见了大佛，买了好物，
paragraphs.en: Ate well. Saw the Buddha. Bought the things worth buying.

paragraphs.zh: 还收获了一只毛巾小象。
paragraphs.en: Came home with a towel elephant.

paragraphs.zh: 旅行的意义不在于抵达终点，
paragraphs.en: The meaning of travel is not the arrival —

paragraphs.zh: 而是我们一起走过的那些路。
paragraphs.en: it's the roads we walked together.
